description: Set up the development environment by installing dependencies and verifying the existing build and tests pass.
steps: Run `npm ci` in /projects/sandbox/mynah-ui to install root dependencies.
Run `npm run build` in /projects/sandbox/mynah-ui to build the library and verify it compiles successfully.
Run `npm run tests:unit` in /projects/sandbox/mynah-ui to verify existing unit tests pass.
Run `cd example && npm install && npm run build` to verify the example app compiles successfully.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run tests:unit` exits with code 0 with all tests passing
`cd example && npm run build` exits with code 0
verification: cd example && npm install && npm run build
findings: All dependencies installed successfully with npm ci. Build produces warnings about asset size (main.js 2.16 MiB) but compiles fine. All 12 test suites (41 tests) pass. Example app builds successfully with Sass deprecation warnings about @import rules. Node.js 22 used. No environment issues encountered.
